layout.house_prompt: A photography studio with a shooting area, an editing room, a client lounge, a dressing room, a props storage, an office, and a bathroom. The shooting area has two studio lights and a backdrop. The editing room has a desk with two monitors and a chair. The client lounge has a sofa and a coffee table. The dressing room has a vanity with a mirror on top and a clothing rack. The props storage has shelves with props including hats and bags. The office has a desk with a chair and a filing cabinet. The bathroom has a toilet and a sink.

hallway.text_description: A modern industrial entry hallway for a photography studio with clean lines, simple wayfinding signage, and durable finishes.

client_lounge.text_description: A modern industrial client lounge with a sofa and a coffee table, comfortable waiting area lighting, and clean minimalist decor.

shooting_area.text_description: A modern industrial photography shooting area with two studio lights and a backdrop, clear open floor space for shooting, and neutral wall tones.

editing_room.text_description: A modern industrial editing room with a desk with two monitors and a chair, cable management, and task lighting.

office.text_description: A modern industrial office with a desk with a chair and a filing cabinet, organized workspace, and minimalist decor.

dressing_room.text_description: A modern industrial dressing room with a vanity with a mirror on top and a clothing rack, good lighting for makeup, and privacy.

props_storage.text_description: A modern industrial props storage room with shelves holding props including hats and bags, labeled organization, and durable finishes.

bathroom.text_description: A modern industrial bathroom with a toilet and a sink, easy-clean finishes, and practical lighting.
